rationale: P32 reaction (bed mid-coffee dry sideways glance) lands the push-back without lecturing. Sierra disagrees with the trend's binary — softness vs hustle — by adding the missing piece: structure. Hand-drafted, not Sonnet-planned.
voiceover_text: Vulnerability is power. Sure. But softness without standards isn't femininity, it's compliance. Real femininity has structure. Discipline. Faith. Taste. That's the spine.
caption: Soft girl era is cute. Soft girl with no spine is exhausting. Standards are the structure.
